vision.name: Red Dual Punch
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
[Attack] Physical attack.
Raise your anger 1 level. Banish the top card of each player's discard pile.
[Trait:Namekian]: This attack gains "HIT: Rejuvenate 3." If your anger level is 4 or greater, this attack cannot be stopped.
DAMAGE: AT + 4 stages.
(Banish after use.)
